newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Freedom Furniture flies to record high.
newsitem.headline: Freedom Furniture flies to record high.

text.p: Shares in furniture retailer Freedom Furniture Ltd jumped nearly six percent to a record high A$1.588 on Monday after reporting a sharply higher half year net profit of A$4.65 million.
The company also declared a maiden interim dividend since listing on the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX) in July 1996 of 3.5 cents per share.
Brokers said it was a polished performance even if market expectations had already been high.
"It was an excellent result. The market was expecting that and it has gone up on the back of it," said director of institutions at Ord Minnett, Eric Gale.
Since making its debut on the ASX at 96.3 cents per share, Freedom has climbed about 65 percent to today's record levels.
